title.value: Cron\PruneCronRunLog deletes a real ordo_cron_run_log row past its 30-day retention window

description.value: Closes SCENARIOS.md §11's PruneCronRunLog gap - same shape as PruneNotifications/PrunePendingPopups/PruneSurveyPrompts. No MFTF-reachable path produces a distinctively-identifiable, already-old ordo_cron_run_log row on its own (every real cron's own CronRunLogger::logSummary() text varies by real counts/timestamps), so CronRunLogTestHelper inserts one directly, already past the 30-day retention window (Cron\PruneCronRunLog::RETENTION_DAYS), with a distinctive message - then CronScheduleHelper forces the cron to run now instead of waiting out its real daily schedule. Asserts the row is genuinely gone, not just that the cron didn't throw.

helper.argument: MFTF prune cron run log test fixture row
MFTF prune cron run log test fixture row
